verdict.rationale: Browser support policy is a fair question for a web UI framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents Angular's supported browser matrix or its polyfill guidance; the items cover only CLI commands, features, and community sentiment. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the framework's officially supported browser matrix so I can plan polyfills or decide when to drop legacy support
